fichas.title: Vehicle Repairs: Planning and Construction Guidance
fichas.summary: Guidance for locating and planning a customer-service vehicle repair business. Emphasizes good road access, provision for future expansion, column-free steel shed construction, sealed floors and drainage, exhaust extraction, automatically opening doors with air curtains, and utility connections.
